decisions.reason: The Article 10 category mapping does not change the required author identity, photo source, matching rule, or placement after the category label.
Assigning Article 10 to Culture does not change the rules for requesting images or using text-breakup elements.
The category mapping does not affect the required shape or size of author photographs.
The source concerns the category of a different article and does not alter the Dorian Vale article color restriction or the reservation of red for the cover.
The Article 10 category assignment does not change the Civic Lantern website as the source of article content.
The category mapping adds article metadata but does not modify the magazine's polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The Article 10 category assignment does not change the interactive digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
The category mapping does not change the requirement to enhance image quality with AI when necessary.
The Article 10 category assignment does not alter the deferred print-ready PDF deliverable, resolution, or prepress settings.
